name: Chest Dip
steps: Grip the parallel bars and press up to support yourself with arms straight and shoulders set down.
Lean your torso forward slightly and bend your knees behind you to align your chest over the bars.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest between the bars until you feel a comfortable chest stretch.
Press firmly through the bars to straighten your arms while maintaining your slight forward lean.
tips: Keep your shoulders from tipping forward or shrugging up at the bottom.
Lower only as deep as your shoulder mobility comfortably allows without pain.
